changes: Rename integration module to triha_cpu.
Conditionally instantiate EX1 only when SUPPORT_DUAL_ISSUE is true; otherwise tie its outputs to zero.
Keep original issue, CSR, exception and memory control connections.
Connect maintained frontend and select registered redirect independently of outer MMU.
Connect maintained issue module with payload selection independent of kill/exception controls.
Connect maintained multiplier/CSR data-register derivatives.
Select predictor training register independently from redirect timing.
Connect independent load bypass payload from maintained LSU to both pipeline controllers.

changes: Rename integration module to triha_frontend.
Select existing fetch registered-redirect branch when REGISTER_REDIRECT is enabled; outer MMU remains controlled only by SUPPORT_MMU.
Register complete 70-bit training event one cycle before predictor update, including taken/not-taken events without a miss request.

changes: Select raw payload/class lane from registered expected-PC bit 2 using the existing aligned fetch-FIFO contract; retain full PC/valid matching on issue and accept.
Rename integration module to triha_issue.
Select CSR invalid-instruction payload flag independently of late kill controls; CSR side-effect enable unchanged.
Choose scheduling class and prospective eligibility without late cancellation; apply original squash/CSR cancellation to final fire/accept strobes.
Keep original IRQ inhibit classification on cancellation cycles.
Pass independent load bypass payload to both pipeline controllers, retaining original completion/fault payload.
Connect the maintained register-file wrapper: native zero-latency distributed RAM for single issue; existing generic implementation for dual issue.

changes: Rename integration module to triha_multiplier.
Sample multiplier operand data whenever not held, matching existing execution-unit data registers; pipeline validity still controls result use.
Remove now-unused mult_inst_w decode.

changes: Rename integration module to triha_csr.
Separate wide CSR data registers from late opcode valid, retaining original valid, exception, read-side-effect and commit-write controls.
Decode payload set/clear/immediate independently of valid; valid instructions produce identical data.

changes: Rename integration/helper modules to triha_lsu/triha_lsu_fifo.
Export pure load payload for bypass without response ack/error selection; preserve the original completion/fault address bus and all request/exception controls.
Decode address format and store data without late issue valid; retain final request/unaligned strobe qualification.

changes: Rename module to triha_pipe_ctrl.
Use a separate load-data input for E2 forwarding only; all WB capture, exception, valid and fault-address paths remain unchanged.

Single-issue secondary write must be zero and is checked by simulation; dual issue retains original register-file behavior.
